articles.title: Stablecoins have their 'permission slip.' Now comes the hard part.
articles.snippet: Executives from MoonPay, Ripple and Paxos said at Consensus Miami 2026 that regulation has accelerated stablecoin adoption, but infrastructure, privacy and distribution remain major hurdles.

articles.title: Bitcoin holds $80K into weekly close as traders say BTC price dip not yet over
articles.snippet: Bitcoin avoided a weekend drop as $80,000 stayed in place, but traders saw BTC price action dipping below before continuing higher.

articles.title: Bitcoin price may dip toward $70K as Fed estimates hotter inflation print
articles.snippet: BTC’s rising wedge points to a possible drop toward $70,000 as Strategy pauses buying and inflation cools Fed rate-cut hopes.

articles.title: Crypto exchanges pushed US lawmakers to bar provision on risky tokens: Report
articles.snippet: Three companies reportedly pressed US senators for changes to a crypto bill, removing language that would require them to offer trading on tokens “not readily susceptible to manipulation.”

articles.title: Kraken parent company applies for OCC charter in move toward banking
articles.snippet: The US banking regulator has already approved similar charter applications for Coinbase, Ripple Labs, BitGo, Circle, Fidelity Digital Assets and Paxos.
